procedure.name: NewOrder
procedure.statement: SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ C_DISCOUNT, C_LAST, C_CREDIT FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT /*++ INDEX(DISTRICT, COLUMN D_KEY)*/ D_NEXT_O_ID, D_TAX FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?

SELECT /*++ INDEX(STOCK, COLUMN S_W_I_KEY)*/ S_QUANTITY, S_DATA, CASE ? WHEN 1 THEN S_DIST_01 WHEN 2 THEN S_DIST_02 WHEN 3 THEN S_DIST_03 WHEN 4 THEN S_DIST_04 WHEN 5 THEN S_DIST_05 WHEN 6 THEN S_DIST_06 WHEN 7 THEN S_DIST_07 WHEN 8 THEN S_DIST_08 WHEN 9 THEN S_DIST_09 WHEN 10 THEN S_DIST_10 END AS S_DIST_INFO FROM STOCK WHERE S_W_I_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(DISTRICT, COLUMN D_KEY)*/ DISTRICT SET D_NEXT_O_ID = D_NEXT_O_ID + 1 WHERE D_KEY = ?
INSERT INTO NEW_ORDER (NO_O_ID, NO_D_ID, NO_W_ID, NO_KEY) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO OORDER (O_ID, O_D_ID, O_W_ID, O_C_ID, O_ENTRY_D, O_OL_CNT, O_ALL_LOCAL, O_KEY, O_C_KEY) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(STOCK, COLUMN S_W_I_KEY)*/ STOCK SET S_QUANTITY = ? , S_YTD = S_YTD + ?, S_ORDER_CNT = S_ORDER_CNT + 1, S_REMOTE_CNT = S_REMOTE_CNT + ? WHERE S_W_I_KEY = ?
INSERT INTO ORDER_LINE (OL_O_ID, OL_D_ID, OL_W_ID, OL_NUMBER, OL_I_ID, OL_SUPPLY_W_ID, OL_QUANTITY, OL_AMOUNT, OL_DIST_INFO, OL_O_KEY, OL_W_I_KEY) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
SELECT /*++ INDEX(ITEM, COLUMN I_ID)*/ I_ID, I_PRICE FROM ITEM WHERE I_ID IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT /*++ INDEX(STOCK, COLUMN S_W_I_KEY)*/ S_W_I_KEY, S_QUANTITY, S_DATA, CASE ? WHEN 1 THEN S_DIST_01 WHEN 2 THEN S_DIST_02 WHEN 3 THEN S_DIST_03 WHEN 4 THEN S_DIST_04 WHEN 5 THEN S_DIST_05 WHEN 6 THEN S_DIST_06 WHEN 7 THEN S_DIST_07 WHEN 8 THEN S_DIST_08 WHEN 9 THEN S_DIST_09 WHEN 10 THEN S_DIST_10 END AS S_DIST_INFO FROM STOCK WHERE S_W_I_KEY IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

procedure.name: Payment
procedure.statement: UPDATE /*++ INDEX(WAREHOUSE, COLUMN W_ID)*/ WAREHOUSE SET W_YTD = W_YTD + ? WHERE W_ID = ? RETURNING W_STREET_1, W_STREET_2, W_CITY, W_STATE, W_ZIP, W_NAME
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(DISTRICT, COLUMN D_KEY)*/ DISTRICT SET D_YTD = D_YTD + ? WHERE D_KEY = ? RETURNING D_STREET_1, D_STREET_2, D_CITY, D_STATE, D_ZIP, D_NAME
SELECT /*++ INDEX(DISTRICT, COLUMN D_KEY)*/ D_STREET_1, D_STREET_2, D_CITY, D_STATE, D_ZIP, D_NAME FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?

SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_LAST, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ C_DATA FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = ?, C_YTD_PAYMENT = ?, C_PAYMENT_CNT = ?, C_DATA = ? WHERE C_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = ?, C_YTD_PAYMENT = ?, C_PAYMENT_CNT = ? WHERE C_KEY = ?

UPDATE /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = ?, C_YTD_PAYMENT = ?, C_PAYMENT_CNT = ? WHERE C_KEY = ? RETURNING C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_LAST, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE
INSERT INTO HISTORY (H_C_D_ID, H_C_W_ID, H_C_ID, H_D_ID, H_W_ID, H_DATE, H_AMOUNT, H_DATA, H_C_KEY) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_W_D_LAST_FIRST)*/ C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_ID, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_W_D_LAST_FIRST BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY C_FIRST

procedure.name: OrderStatus
procedure.statement: SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_LAST, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT /*++ INDEX(OORDER, COLUMN O_C_KEY)*/ O_ID, O_CARRIER_ID, O_ENTRY_D FROM OORDER WHERE O_C_KEY = ? ORDER BY O_KEY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT /*++ INDEX(ORDER_LINE, COLUMN OL_O_KEY)*/ OL_I_ID, OL_SUPPLY_W_ID, OL_QUANTITY, OL_AMOUNT, OL_DELIVERY_D FROM ORDER_LINE WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?

SELECT /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_W_D_LAST_FIRST)*/ C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_ID, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_W_D_LAST_FIRST BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY C_FIRST

procedure.name: Delivery
procedure.statement: SELECT /*++ INDEX(NEW_ORDER, COLUMN NO_KEY)*/ NO_O_ID FROM NEW_ORDER WHERE NO_KEY BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY NO_KEY ASC LIMIT 1
DELETE /*++ INDEX(NEW_ORDER, COLUMN NO_KEY)*/ FROM NEW_ORDER WHERE NO_KEY = ?
SELECT /*++ INDEX(OORDER, COLUMN O_KEY)*/ O_C_ID FROM OORDER WHERE O_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(OORDER, COLUMN O_KEY)*/ OORDER SET O_CARRIER_ID = ? WHERE O_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(ORDER_LINE, COLUMN OL_O_KEY)*/ ORDER_LINE SET OL_DELIVERY_D = ? WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?
SELECT /*++ INDEX(ORDER_LINE, COLUMN OL_O_KEY)*/ SUM(OL_AMOUNT) AS OL_TOTAL FROM ORDER_LINE WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?
UPDATE /*++ INDEX(CUSTOMER, COLUMN C_KEY)*/ CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = C_BALANCE + ?, C_DELIVERY_CNT = C_DELIVERY_CNT + 1 WHERE C_KEY = ?

procedure.name: StockLevel
procedure.statement: SELECT /*++ INDEX(DISTRICT, COLUMN D_KEY)*/ D_NEXT_O_ID FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?

SELECT /*++ INDEX(STOCK, COLUMN S_W_I_KEY)*/ COUNT(*) AS STOCK_COUNT FROM STOCK WHERE S_W_I_KEY IN ( SELECT /*++ INDEX(ORDER_LINE, COLUMN OL_O_KEY)*/ OL_W_I_KEY FROM ORDER_LINE WHERE OL_O_KEY < ? AND OL_O_KEY >= ? ) AND S_QUANTITY < ?
